scope: Exact full-byte SMT input oracle for requested library and binary targets sharing the package name demo; instrumentation acceptance, not a performance benchmark or a Current/reuse guarantee.

machine.execution: Native macOS arm64 development host with concurrent development traffic

instrumentation.sail: Byte-identical hardlink of frozen production Sail
instrumentation.shim: Observation wrapper forwards argv, stdin and stdout unchanged to frozen production sail-z3
instrumentation.policy: Default solver mode, default pinned Z3 options and seeds; no query normalization. Plain cargo verus verification and managed verification use the same source paths.
instrumentation.classification: Instrumented runtime context differs from an ordinary installation; timings are not product benchmark results.

currentness_qualification: The managed cold invocation honestly reported historical. This oracle establishes exact requested-target bytes and fresh complete target reports; it does not establish Current or receipt reuse on macOS.

all_session_differences.qualification: Three vstd session inputs differ in declaration/fuel ordering (VI-0001). Requested lib/bin sessions are separately selected and compared as entire bytes, without normalization or exclusions from their target checks.
